mathematical_result: For any family P_n of complex polynomials in Fin 4 sum Fin 3 with each P_n homogeneous of degree n, the literal grouped family A_j,gamma = ksSpectatorCoefficientPolynomial(P_(j+sum gamma),equivFunOnFinite.symm gamma) has groupedHomogeneousSpectatorPolynomial A n = P_n. The single-degree evaluation identity sums over a finite exponent set proved exactly equal to gamma.degree <= n.
proof_checks: The finite spectator exponent set is the tail image of the pre-existing exact four-index total-degree antidiagonal. Tail degree is the sum of its three spectator entries.
On the fixed total-degree set the tail projection is injective: equal tails have equal sums and therefore equal nonnegative head entries. Fin.cases recovers every coordinate.
Membership in the projected set is equivalent to gamma.degree <= n. The reverse witness has head n-gamma.degree and exactly the original tail; the inequality justifies Nat subtraction.

Actual outer spectator support lies in this finite set because any coefficient with gamma.degree > n is separately proved zero. Additional bounded exponents outside the support contribute zero. No inference from truncated homogeneity alone is used.
For each grouped term, total-degree membership rewrites the selected polynomial P_(w0+sum tail) to P_n. Injective Finset.sum_image reconstructs the literal finite sum without multiplicity.
Complex polynomial evaluation extensionality promotes equality at every complex coordinate assignment to equality of the original polynomials. No physical relation between coordinates is imposed.
The construction handles n=0 and P_n=0. IsHomogeneous includes zero; no nonzero-degree assertion is made.
